authoritative: Source: the Department of Elections' official 1996 results book, whose county columns add up to each candidate's printed state total; they replace Algara and Amlani's county rows.
title: Official results of general election, 1996

pages.hint: The county columns are City of Wilmington, Rural New Castle County, Kent County, Sussex County, then Total Votes Cast; leave out the Majority column. Read only the president block (or the governor block on the governor page); every candidate line and the Total Votes Cast line is a row, and a Writeln Votes line with no figures is not a row.
